cantrips.name: Fire Bolt
cantrips.description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack.

cantrips.name: Eldritch Blast
cantrips.description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack.

cantrips.name: Mage Hand
cantrips.description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. You can use your action to control the hand to manipulate objects.

cantrips.name: Minor Illusion
cantrips.description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration.

cantrips.name: Sacred Flame
cantrips.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage.

cantrips.name: Ray of Frost
cantrips.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. On a hit, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

cantrips.name: Guidance
cantrips.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice.

level_1.name: Magic Missile
level_1.description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range without an attack roll.

level_1.name: Shield
level_1.description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.

level_1.name: Cure Wounds
level_1.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

level_1.name: Healing Word
level_1.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

level_1.name: Guiding Bolt
level_1.description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. On a hit, the next attack roll made against this target before the end of your next turn has advantage.

level_1.name: Thunderwave
level_1.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you must make a Constitution saving throw.

level_1.name: Mage Armor
level_1.description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

level_2.name: Misty Step
level_2.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

level_2.name: Scorching Ray
level_2.description: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. You can hurl them at one target or several.

level_2.name: Hold Person
level_2.description: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration.

level_2.name: Invisibility
level_2.description: A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person.

level_3.name: Fireball
level_3.description: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame in a 20-foot radius.

level_3.name: Counterspell
level_3.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. If the creature is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, its spell fails.

level_3.name: Lightning Bolt
level_3.description: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose.

level_3.name: Revivify
level_3.description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point.

high_level_staples.name: Polymorph
high_level_staples.description: This spell transforms a creature with at least 1 hit point that you can see within range into a new form.

high_level_staples.name: Greater Invisibility
high_level_staples.description: You or a creature you touch becomes invisible for up to 1 minute, persisting through attacks and spellcasting.

high_level_staples.name: Wall of Force
high_level_staples.description: An invisible wall of force springs into existence at a point you choose within range.

high_level_staples.name: Heal
high_level_staples.description: A surge of positive energy washes through the creature, restoring 70 hit points and curing blindness and diseases.

high_level_staples.name: Teleport
high_level_staples.description: This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures to a destination you select.

high_level_staples.name: Wish
high_level_staples.description: The mightiest spell a mortal creature can cast, reshaping the very foundations of reality.
